sandbox_policy.note: The evaluation never passes --no-sandbox or any other sandbox switch to the application. The only sandbox-related action is making Electron's own SUID helper binary correctly configured (root-owned, mode 4755), which is what Chromium itself requires on Linux and is what keeps the sandbox enabled; without it Chromium aborts rather than run unsandboxed.
